section: 5. Before the Demon King's Castle: The Critical Choice
description: The party arrives before the Demon King's castle. The guidance of the Evil God's power and the struggle of inner affection intertwine in Dolores's heart, forcing the party's final decision.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Just as she was about to further explain that we are actually on the same side, everyone had already unanimously interpreted it as: "The current player3 is not the real player3. She has been replaced." "The current player3 is a traitor swapped in by the Demon King." "Huh!? Huh!? Don't say that, I just found out she's my mother's my mother! I was almost about to persuade her to—" (I end everyone's free interpretation) player4@player4 extrapower perpetual motion machine 2 fun-seeker 2 2 Trait: extrapower! Intent: Trample that Demon King! And that spy! Mold them with the power of "I reckon"! Calamity: Can't fight! Just can't fight at all!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .r4d6

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: <Sera Hara Nai> rolled 4d6=[4d6=16, 6+3+6+1]=16

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Dolores... you!" player5 looked at Dolores, an incredulous expression in his eyes. "Have you always been the Demon King's person? When exactly did you... What does our previous adventure count for then... No? Are you still Dolores?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4's boundless energy burns fiercely. Regardless, a traitor has appeared among the masses! player4 and his companions point their swords at the traitor. player4 has disliked this guy for a long time and wants to just hack him to pieces, but his clever companions want to pry information from his mouth! So everyone ties up the traitor. Tied up! player4 is a bit annoyed he couldn't fight, so he gives a few extra kicks. The Demon King quietly observes all this from the side. No one knows if the Demon King has a backup plan or simply doesn't care about this traitor. The adventuring party quickly restrains the traitor and leaves him aside, pointing swords, staffs, and all sorts of weapons at the Demon King. player4 lets out a loud shout and leaps forward, hacking and hammering wildly at the Demon King, pinning the Demon King to the seat with a sword and then delivering several powerful punches to the Demon King's stomach. Of course, the Demon King's resistance is strong and forceful, easily leaving player4 at low health, but low-health player4 burns with even more surging fighting spirit, banging and hammering wildly.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: So, the Demon King is now beaten to near death, and player3 is tied up.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Kicked a few times but with trash-tier stamina, player3 faints on the spot.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Since this player3 is likely not the real player3, where exactly is your companion then?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "C-calm down, little player4! My intuition tells me little Dolores is little Dolores, even if she has a connection to the Demon King, she's still little Dolores!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4 doesn't know, player4 blissfully collapses on the ground.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "And everyone else, calm down...!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: However, she won't faint, she goes up and gives Dolores two more kicks.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "player3!" player8 rushes over, helping up the already unconscious player3. The information overload was too much, she's currently brainstorming.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player4 extrapower perpetual motion machine 2 fun-seeker 2 2 (Damn, is this 'she' player3? Should I be kicked awake or...?)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: (Go all out against the Demon King!) player2 Intent: Persuade everyone that little Dolores hasn't been replaced. Since she hasn't been replaced, then whatever little Dolores did doesn't matter, right? We should stay together forever! Calamity: Persuasion failed! Everyone firmly believes player2's mind has also been corrupted by the Demon King, and knocks player2 unconscious.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: .r7d6

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "No matter what her relationship with the Demon King is, little Dolores is little Dolores. I'm very sensitive to changes in the surroundings. Until the moment you knocked her out, little Dolores still liked to lower her head by 10 degrees when speaking, and would slightly turn her body by 2 centimeters. These little habits are absolutely impossible for others to replicate!" "So I'm sure she's definitely still little player3!" "Since little Dolores hasn't been replaced, what does it matter if she's the Demon King's sister, daughter, granddaughter, or ex-girlfriend! Since we promised to form an adventuring party for a lifetime, shouldn't we stay together forever? The help little Dolores provided for us in the adventuring party before wasn't fake either!" Although they feel this guy's reasoning is a bit twisted, since their companion hasn't been replaced, everyone unties player3.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Normally, an explanation would be needed, but Hidariva is just a lively, energetic warrior who doesn't really care about these things. Let whoever cares deal with it.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: Ah, player8 didn't observe that! Damn, I really don't love everyone enough. If only I loved everyone more... @player2 player6 count 2 Why can't we all be together? +4 No, that's not right, this matters a lot! player8 just brainstormed a result.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Dolores, you... what were you about to do just now?"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: Known fact 1: The Demon King said we are all "His" playthings; Known fact 2: player8 only wants to be the plaything of the adventuring party's members... So, as long as player3 is that "Him", the problem is solved! player8 has completely figured it out! Introduce trait: Love-obsessed heavy girl + mind control

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Uh... I just said, after our adventuring party defeats the Demon King, we should also stay together for a lifetime..." player8 Intent: Plant a suggestion in player3, making her believe she is the "Him" mentioned by the Demon King. Calamity: player3 is not affected by her own suggestion. player8's mental suggestion hits herself, making her firmly believe player3 is that "Him".

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: .r7d6

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: player8 holds player3's hand, silently thinking to herself that actually player3 is the "Him" who manipulates the world as mentioned by the Demon King. She is both the Demon King's daughter and the actual ruler of the world... But, what does that matter? That's even better. No matter what, please, player3-sama, keep toying with me forever... player3's eyes dim for a moment, then brighten again.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Ah... so that's how it is..." The untied player3 speaks, looking at everyone with already pale pupils. I activate: Not Healing. Intent: Suck everyone unconscious, then heal my own wounds. Calamity: Flesh begins to grow on the body, truly manifesting the characteristics of "Him".

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player5 feels that Dolores, touched by Landriel, has a changed look in her eyes. He senses an indescribable sense of strangeness.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Bet 0, come on .r3d6

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3 gently hugs each teammate, and upon contact, each teammate loses vitality to the point of being unable to maintain consciousness.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hehe... If you think so, then so be it."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The Demon King continues: "But in fact."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: While player3 is draining her teammates' life, she suddenly discovers that player4's life force is endless.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Wh... what's going on!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "?! I actually fell asleep?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Your existence fills me with hatred, yet also, with affection." player3 embraces player4.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "?? Are you crazy?"
